run_summary: The runtime data contains routine weather and volcanic ash forecasts, as well as several administrative announcements from JR Central, JR West, and Kyoto City. No major travel disruptions or urgent alerts were identified. A new real-time information service for the Tokaido Shinkansen via the 'Japan Travel by NAVITIME' app is the most actionable traveler update.

candidates.title: Tokaido Shinkansen Real-Time Status Now Available on Japan Travel by NAVITIME App
candidates.what_changed: JR Central has integrated real-time Tokaido Shinkansen operation information into the 'Japan Travel by NAVITIME' navigation app.
candidates.why_it_matters: International travelers can now receive live updates on train status directly within a popular English-language navigation app, improving trip planning and disruption management.
candidates.traveler_action: Download or update the 'Japan Travel by NAVITIME' app to access real-time Shinkansen status.
